messages.subject: peakAlign
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

I have a question about peakAlign function. Me and my colleague used the same file for processing, but in package version 3.4.3 the result of aligning is 338 peaks while in package version 3.0.1 number of peaks are more than 4000. What can be a reason and how we can compare our results?

Thank you in advance and best regards,
Sofya

messages.subject: Re: Error when loading my data
messages.body_plain:
Hi Cindy,
to load a file try using the following code:

myFile <- " C:/Users/txd/Desktop/cardinal3/Slide1-Pten-WT2-neg/Slide1-Pten-WT2-neg.imzML "
d <- readMSIData(myFile)

In the first line, you should specify the path. You may not need the 'C:' at the beginning of the line, but that depends on how your computer wants the path to be written.

Let me know how this works out!

Best,
Giulia
